output.body:
## Summary

Assemble the retained-display batch into one master change so its production deployment happens once. The combined head includes each source PR and its repairs:

```text
master ← #150 World poses ← #151 pickup clocks ← #152 renderer parents
       ← #153 combat Points/movement ← final combined gate
```

The native failure was traced to the test pilot coasting out while cleared-field rewards were still arriving, then opening first-secondary help during transit. The source intentionally leaves that crossing pending. The pilot now steers inward with ordinary keys until collection; production state behavior and all test gates stay intact. Two new regressions fail before and pass after.

The final layer records source identities, validation, negative controls and remaining limits. It preserves all four exact source heads; master and the original recreation checkpoint remain unchanged until this PR's required job succeeds.

## Evidence

- **Before:** rendering and combat used different ancestry; raw pickup/actor arrays and scalar camera accumulation could disagree with actual retained clips.
  **After:** original-backed retained owners supply rendering and combat Points, with full-frame movement/teleport regressions and detached/replaced identity checks.
- Formatting, TypeScript and all 1,131 unit tests / 16,325 assertions pass. Eighteen ancestry controls pass 213 assertions; independent original capture verification matches 112 rows / 2,576 Numbers.
- Fresh build `-Op3ze2z_uXkObma46lfY` passes both affected playthroughs: mock **68,999** frames, supplied art **67,433**, all six upgrades, help once, no downgrades, Boss Badge. All **729** prebuild inputs match. The **74** unaffected cases passed on unchanged production source in the prior cohort; this is not one new 76-case build.
- Every source head is an ancestor. `vercel.json` still suppresses `stack/**` deployments; no provider skip is inferred from absent statuses.
- Reproduction, scope and remaining differences are recorded in `docs/retained-display-batch-validation.md` and its linked references.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** gameplay

This batch changes physical display ownership, artwork lifetimes and field-relative combat/movement. Require the latest exact combined-head **Rules, build and mock browser** job and no actionable review findings before one master merge. Earlier layer checks and CodeRabbit skips do not substitute for that gate.

Native dynamic field geometry/width queries, global entropy/event scheduling, ordinary full progression and original/Adobe/pixel/audio/full-game parity remain unfinished.

Created with gpt-6.1-sol in T3 Code (Codex harness), including gpt-6.1-sol subagents.

## Summary

Effect registration stored raw fractional positions instead of MovieClip display coordinates. It now preserves queued Number arguments and applies twip precision at registration: `13.049/-23.049 → 13/-23`.

```text
existing display owners
  → physical field population (order and object identity preserved)
  → geometry provider/traversals (follow-up)

preserved original camera/effect captures
  → frozen numeric fixtures and independent verifiers
```

Adds the source-backed population seam, repeatable numeric effect metadata, and original camera/effect qualification tools. Most additions are numeric oracle fixtures. No original SWF, artwork, audio or capture is bundled. The population/metadata are not yet connected to gameplay queries.

This is layer 1 of the next five-PR stack. Keep `stack/**` Vercel suppression and land the assembled final layer through one master merge.

## Evidence

- **Before:** both new queued/immediate position regressions fail.
  **After:** positions use signed twips while queued arguments, object identity and registration order remain intact.
- Formatting, TypeScript and **1,166 tests / 17,793 assertions** pass. Seven population cases reject eight semantic mutations.
- The registration correction passed **12 mock/SWF browser cases**, zero skips/flaky results, on build `cnC5ZnrgsKzrSI2ZEdSt-`. Later additions are unused population/metadata and research; this is the scoped browser result, not a fresh full-branch playthrough.
- Original camera: 400 rows / 12,400 binary Numbers; 15 rejecting controls. Original effects: two fresh captures of 21,636 rows / 259,632 Numbers each; parent independently reverified both and reran 18 forgery controls.
- Effect replay still has 59 frame and 45 identity/correspondence differences, plus 399 transient original lookup holes. Those gaps are recorded, not repaired or waived. The disputed mask draft is excluded.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** Simulation

The gameplay change is registration-time position precision. Complete native/mock field geometry, retained effect owner/descendant integration and mask qualification remain follow-ups. REA event completeness, ordinary progression and Adobe/full-game parity are unproved.

## Summary

The field-query draft used an all-active-mask policy that disagrees with the preserved original at overlapping masks and exact end depths. Qualify the actual builtin behavior and apply it in an unused geometry boundary before migrating gameplay callers.

```text
physical field owners → explicit geometry provider
                        ├─ declared-leaf Script bounds
                        └─ shape contact + depth latch + retained runtime masks
```

Layer 2 of the five-PR effect/geometry stack, based on #155. Also correct the effect comparison tool to walk current render order rather than Map insertion history. Gameplay queries remain on their existing implementation while complete geometry and public root-coordinate mapping are qualified.

## Evidence

- **Before:** retaining an earlier mask miss, excluding the exact mask-end depth, or ignoring a runtime mask reference each fails the unchanged frozen-original assertions. Effect comparison used the wrong child correspondence after replacement.
  **After:** two independent original captures agree on 97 rows / 2,522 binary values; all 21 capture/byte forgery controls reject. The traversal matches measured overlap, visibility and reference-lifetime controls; all three semantic mutations reject. Correct render-order comparison removes 45 spurious identity differences without changing production or the oracle.
- `bun run format`, `bun run check`: 1,193 tests / 19,427 assertions pass. Focused traversal: 18 tests / 179 assertions. `git diff --check` passes.
- Original scripts, tags, runtime identities, limits and reproduction commands are recorded in the scoped references. No SWF/media/captures are committed. Application E2E is not repeated for modules with no application caller.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Reversible code and numeric evidence additions. No complete native/mock geometry provider or gameplay migration. The public hitTestPoint root mapping, text contact, retained effect poses, and complete-game/Adobe parity remain unresolved.

**Blast Radius:** geometry

`stack/**` deployment suppression is retained. Do not merge this intermediate layer to master; assemble five layers, validate the final combined head, then perform one master merge.
